weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 1 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

weaknesses.detail: 20/31 passes (64%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

push.title: L 4-5 vs Da1e FC | You: 10.0 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
BellyTb1, that 10.0 is the kind of night that makes an old coach believe in magic. Top 10% of midfielders.

DID WELL
+ 31 passes (up from your usual 20). You kept the engine turning over.
+ 2 key passes (up from your usual 0). You turned nothing into something more than once.
+ A hat trick against Da1e FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's a striker's instinct, and you can't teach that at a clinic.
+ Man of the Match, your 5th for us. You carried the moment and carried us.
+ You and PhogsToffees play like you've known each other since kindergarten.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
- 64% passing (20 of 31, down from your usual 73%). Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
- Beaten 4-5 by Da1e FC. Let's use it.

Quick drill: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.

Stay hydrated and humble. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.detail: Shots on target: 25% (bottom quarter of forwards is 60% or less)
weaknesses.title: Shot selection
tips: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.
weaknesses.coach: A few too many shots went wide or over. Better looks, better results.

push.title: L 4-5 vs Da1e FC | You: 9.6 (top 10% FOR)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 9.6 against Da1e FC. I'm gonna need a minute. Somebody hand me a tissue and a clipboard.

DID WELL
+ 4 shots at Da1e FC's goal. Shots are tickets to the goal lottery, and you bought a stack.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 2). You saw passes other folks didn't even know existed.
+ A goal against Da1e FC, your 3rd straight match scoring. Ball in the net, smile on my face. That's the deal.
+ Keep finding BellyTb1; it's working like a charm.
+ 1.8 above your average. That's a staircase and you're climbing.

WORK ON
- 1 of 4 shots on target. Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
- Pass accuracy: 78%. Halfway to the summit; the peak is 88%+.
- Fell 4-5 to Da1e FC. Tomorrow's a better story.

Work on: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

Go tell somebody you love about that one. - Coach Lasso
